39.2: And have turned you back, and enticed you, And caused you to come up from the sides of the north, And brought you in against mountains of Israel,
39.3: And have smitten your bow out of your left hand, Yes, your arrows out of your right I cause to fall.
39.4: On mountains of Israel you fall, You, and all your bands, and the peoples who are with you, To ravenous fowl--a bird of every wing, And to a beast of the field, I have given you for food.
39.5: On the face of the field you fall, for I have spoken, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
39.6: And I have sent a fire against Magog, And against the confident inhabitants of the isles, And they have known that I am Jehovah.
39.7: And My holy name I make known in the midst of My people Israel, And I pollute not My holy name any more, And known have the nations that I, Jehovah, the Holy One, am in Israel.
39.8: Indeed, it has come, and it has been done, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, It is the day of which I spoke.
39.9: And gone out have the inhabitants of cities of Israel, And they have burned and kindled a fire, With armour, and shield, and buckler, With bow, and with arrows, And with hand-staves, and with javelins, And they have caused a fire to burn with them seven years,
39.10: And they do not take wood out of the field, Nor do they hew out of the forests, For with armour they cause the fire to burn, And they have spoiled their spoilers, And they have plundered their plunderers, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
39.11: And it has come to pass, in that day, I give to Gog a place there--a grave in Israel, the valley of those passing by, east of the sea, and it is stopping those passing by, and they have buried there Gog, and all his multitude, and have cried, O valley of the multitude of Gog!
39.12: And the house of Israel have buried them--in order to cleanse the land--seven months.
39.13: Yes, all the people of the land have buried them, and it has been to them for a name--the day of My being honoured--an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
39.14: And men for continual employment they separate, passing on through the land, burying with those passing by those who are left on the face of the earth, to cleanse it: at the end of seven months they search.
39.15: And those passing by have passed through the land, and seen a bone of man, and one has constructed near it a sign till those burying have buried it in the valley of the multitude of Gog.
39.16: And also the name of the city is The multitude; and they have cleansed the land.
39.17: And you, son of man, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Say to the bird--every wing, and to every beast of the field: Be assembled and come in, Be gathered from round about, For My sacrifice that I am sacrificing for you, A great sacrifice on mountains of Israel, And you have eaten flesh, and drunk blood.
39.18: Flesh of the mighty you do eat, And blood of princes of the earth you drink, Of rams, of lambs, and of he-goats, Of calves, fatlings of Bashan--all of them.
39.19: And you have eaten fat to satiety, And you have drunk blood--to drunkenness, Of My sacrifice that I sacrificed for you.
39.20: And you have been satisfied at My table with horse and rider, Mighty man, and every man of war, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
39.21: And I have given My honour among nations, And seen have all the nations My Judgment that I have done, And My hand that I have laid on them.
39.22: And known have the house of Israel that I am Jehovah their God, From that day and now.
39.23: And known have the nations that for their iniquity, Removed have the house of Israel, Because they have trespassed against Me, And I do hide My face from them, And give them into the hand of their adversaries, And they fall by sword--all of them.
39.24: According to their uncleanness, And according to their transgressions, I have done with them, And I do hide My face from them.
39.25: Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Now do I bring back the captivity of Jacob, And I have pitied all the house of Israel, And have been zealous for My holy name.
39.26: And they have forgotten their shame, And all their trespass that they trespassed against Me, In their dwelling on their land confidently and none troubling.
39.27: In My bringing them back from the peoples, I have assembled them from the lands of their enemies, And I have been sanctified in them before the eyes of the many nations,
39.28: And they have known that I am Jehovah their God, In My removing them to the nations, And I have gathered them to their land, And I leave none of them any more there.
39.29: And I hide not any more My face from them, In that I have poured out My spirit on the house of Israel, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah!'

40.1: In the twenty and fifth year of our removal, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city was smitten, in this self-same day has a hand of Jehovah been upon me, and He brings me in there;
40.2: in visions of God He has brought me in to the land of Israel, and causes me to rest on a very high mountain, and upon it is as the frame of a city on the south.
40.3: And He brings me in there, and indeed, a man, his appearance as the appearance of brass, and a thread of flax in his hand, and a measuring-reed, and he is standing at the gate,
40.4: and the man speaks to me: `Son of man, see with your eyes, And with your ears hear, And set your heart to all that I am shewing you, For, in order to show it you, You have been brought in here, Declare all that you are seeing to the house of Israel.'
40.5: And indeed, a wall on the outside of the house all round about, and in the hand of the man a measuring-reed, six cubits by a cubit and a handbreadth, and he measures the breadth of the building one reed, and the height one reed.
40.6: And he comes in to the gate whose front is eastward, and he goes up by its steps, and he measures the threshold of the gate one reed broad, even the one threshold one reed broad,
40.7: and the little chamber one reed long and one reed broad, and between the little chambers five cubits, and the threshold of the gate, from the side of the porch of the gate from within, one reed.
40.8: And he measures the porch of the gate from within one reed,
40.9: and he measures the porch of the gate eight cubits, and its posts two cubits, and the porch of the gates from within,
40.10: and the little chambers of the gate eastward, three on this side, and three on that side; one measure is to them three, and one measure is to the posts, on this side and on that side.
40.11: And he measures the breadth of the opening of the gate ten cubits, the length of the gate thirteen cubits;
40.12: and a border before the little chambers, one cubit, and one cubit is the border on this side, and the little chamber is six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
40.13: And he measures the gate from the roof of the one little chamber to the roof of another; the breadth twenty and five cubits, opening over-against opening.
40.14: And he makes the posts of sixty cubits, even to the post of the court, the gate all round about;
40.15: and by the front of the gate of the entrance, by the front of the porch of the inner gate, fifty cubits;
40.16: and narrow windows are to the little chambers, and to their posts at the inside of the gate all round about--and so to the arches--and windows all round about are at the inside, and at the post are palm-trees.
40.17: And he brings me in to the outer court, and indeed, chambers and a pavement made for the court all round about--thirty chambers on the pavement--
40.18: and the pavement to the side of the gates over-against the length of the gates is the lower pavement;
40.19: and he measures the breadth from before the lower gate, to the front of the inner court, on the outside, a hundred cubits, eastward and northward.
40.20: As to the gate of the outer court whose front is northward, he has measured its length and its breadth;
40.21: and its little chambers, three on this side, and three on that side, and its posts and its arches have been according to the measure of the first gate, fifty cubits its length, and the breadth five and twenty by the cubit;
40.22: and its windows, and its arches, and its palm-trees are according to the measure of the gate whose face is eastward, and by seven steps they go up on it, and its arches are before them.
40.23: And the gate of the inner court is over-against the gate at the north and at the east; and he measures from gate to gate, a hundred cubits.
40.24: And he causes me to go southward, and indeed, a gate southward, and he has measured its posts and its arches according to these measures;
40.25: and windows are to it and to its arches all round about, like these windows, fifty cubits the length, and the breadth five and twenty cubits;
40.26: and seven steps are its ascent, and its arches are before them, and palm-trees are to it, one on this side, and one on that side, at its posts;
40.27: and the gate of the inner court is southward, and he measures from gate to gate southward, a hundred cubits.
40.28: And he brings me in to the inner court by the south gate, and he measures the south gate according to these measures;
40.29: and its little chambers, and its posts, and its arches are according to these measures, and windows are to it and to its arches all round about; fifty cubits the length, and the breadth twenty and five cubits.
40.30: As to the arches all round about, the length is five and twenty cubits, and the breadth five cubits;
40.31: and its arches are to the outer court, and palm-trees are to its posts, and eight steps are its ascent.
40.32: And he brings me in to the inner court eastward, and he measures the gate according to these measures;
40.33: and its little chambers, and its posts, and its arches are according to these measures: and windows are to it and to its arches all round about, the length fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits;
40.34: and its arches are toward the outer court, and palm-trees are toward its posts, on this side and on that side, and eight steps are its ascent.
40.35: And he brings me in to the north gate, and has measured according to these measures;
40.36: its little chambers, its posts, and its arches; and windows are to it all round about: the length fifty cubits, and the breadth five and twenty cubits;
40.37: and its posts are to the outer court, and palm-trees are to its posts, on this side and on that side, and eight steps are its ascent.
40.38: And the chamber and its opening is by the posts of the gates, there they purge the burnt-offering.
40.39: And in the porch of the gate are two tables on this side, and two tables on that side, to slaughter on them the burnt-offering, and the sin-offering, and the guilt-offering;
40.40: and at the side without, at the going up to the opening of the north gate, are two tables; and at the other side that is at the porch of the gate, are two tables;
40.41: four tables are on this side, and four tables on that side, at the side of the gate, eight tables on which they slaughter.
40.42: And the four tables for burnt-offering are of hewn stone: the length one cubit and a half, and the breadth one cubit and a half, and the height one cubit: on them they place the instruments with which they slaughter the burnt-offering and the sacrifice.
40.43: And the boundaries are one handbreadth, prepared within all round about: and on the tables is the flesh of the offering.
40.44: And on the outside of the inner gate are chambers of the singers, in the inner court, that are at the side of the north gate, and their fronts are southward, one at the side of the east gate has the front northward.
40.45: And he speaks to me: `This chamber, whose front is southward, is for priests keeping charge of the house;
40.46: and the chamber, whose front is northward, is for priests keeping charge of the altar: they are sons of Zadok, who are drawing near of the sons of Levi to Jehovah, to serve Him.'
40.47: And he measures the court: the length a hundred cubits, and the breadth a hundred cubits, square, and the altar is before the house.
40.48: And he brings me in to the porch of the house, and he measures the post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side, and the breadth of the gate, three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side;
40.49: the length of the porch twenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; and by the steps by which they go up to it: and pillars are at the posts, one on this side, and one on that side.

41.1: And he brings me in to the temple, and he measures the posts, six cubits the breadth on this side, and six cubits the breadth on that side--the breadth of the tent.
41.2: And the breadth of the opening is ten cubits; and the sides of the opening are five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side; and he measures its length forty cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
41.3: And he has gone inward, and measures the post of the opening two cubits, and the opening six cubits, and the breadth of the opening seven cubits.
41.4: And he measures its length twenty cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits, to the front of the temple, and he says to me, `This is the holy of holies.'
41.5: And he measures the wall of the house six cubits, and the breadth of the side-chamber four cubits, all round the house round about.
41.6: And the side-chambers are side-chamber by side-chamber, three and thirty times; and they are entering into the wall--which the house has for the side-chambers all round about--to be taken hold of, and they are not taken hold of by the wall of the house.
41.7: And a broad place and a turning place still upwards are to the side-chambers, for the turning round of the house is still upwards all round about the house: therefore the breadth of the house is upwards, and so the lower one goes up to the higher by the midst.
41.8: And I have looked at the house, the height all round about: the foundations of the side-chambers are the fulness of the reed, six cubits by the joining.
41.9: The breadth of the wall that is to the side-chamber at the outside is five cubits; and that which is left is the place of the side-chambers that are to the house.
41.10: And between the chambers is a breadth of twenty cubits round about the house, all round about.
41.11: And the opening of the side-chamber is to the place left, one opening northward, and one opening southward, and the breadth of the place that is left is five cubits all round about.
41.12: As to the building that is at the front of the separate place at the corner westward, the breadth is seventy cubits, and the wall of the building five cubits broad all round about, and its length ninety cubits.
41.13: And he has measured the house, the length is a hundred cubits; and the separate place, and the building, and its walls, the length is a hundred cubits;
41.14: and the breadth of the front of the house, and of the separate place eastward, a hundred cubits.
41.15: And he has measured the length of the building to the front of the separate place that is at its hinder part, and its galleries on this side and on that side, a hundred cubits, and the inner temple and the porches of the court,
41.16: the thresholds, and the narrow windows, and the galleries round about them three, over-against the threshold, a ceiling of wood all round about, and the ground to the windows and the covered windows,
41.17: over above the opening, and to the inner-house, and at the outside, and by all the wall all round about within and without by measure.
41.18: And it is made with cherubs and palm-trees, and a palm-tree is between cherub and cherub, and two faces are to the cherub;
41.19: and the face of man is to the palm-tree on this side, and the face of a young lion to the palm-tree on that side; it is made to all the house all round about.
41.20: from the earth to above the opening are the cherubs and the palm-trees made, and on the wall of the temple.
41.21: Of the temple the side post is square, and of the front of the sanctuary, the appearance is as the appearance.
41.22: Of the altar, the wood is three cubits in height, and its length two cubits; and its corners are to it, and its length, and its walls are of wood, and he speaks to me, `This is the table that is before Jehovah.'
41.23: And two doors are to the temple and to the sanctuary;
41.24: and two leaves are to the doors, two turning leaves are to the doors, two to the one door, and two leaves to the other.
41.25: And made on them, on the doors of the temple, are cherubs and palm-trees as are made on the walls, and a thickness of wood is at the front of the porch on the outside.
41.26: And narrow windows and palm-trees are on this side, and on that side, at the sides of the porch, and the side-chambers of the house, and the thick places.

42.1: And he brings me forth to the outer court, the way northward, and he brings me in to the chamber that is over-against the separate place, and that is over-against the building at the north.
42.2: At the front of the length is a hundred cubits at the north opening, and the breadth fifty cubits.
42.3: Over-against the twenty cubits that are to the inner court, and over-against the pavement that is to the outer court, is gallery over-against gallery, in the three storeys.
42.4: And at the front of the chambers is a walk of ten cubits in breadth to the inner part, a way of one cubit, and their openings are at the north.
42.5: And the upper chambers are short, for the galleries contain more than these, than the lower, and than the middle one, of the building;
42.6: for they are threefold, and they have no pillars as the pillars of the court, therefore it has been kept back--more than the lower and than the middle one--from the ground.
42.7: As to the wall that is at the outside, over-against the chambers, the way of the outer-court at the front of the chambers, its length is fifty cubits;
42.8: for the length of the chambers that are to the outer court is fifty cubits, and of those on the front of the temple a hundred cubits.
42.9: And under these chambers is the entrance from the east, in one's going into them from the outer court.
42.10: In the breadth of the wall of the court eastward, to the front of the separate place, and to the front of the building, are chambers.
42.11: And the way before them is as the appearance of the chambers that are northward, according to their length so is their breadth, and all their outlets, and according to their fashions, and according to their openings.
42.12: And according to the openings of the chambers that are southward is an opening at the head of the way, the way directly in the front of the wall eastward in entering them.
42.13: And he says to me, `The north chambers, the south chambers, that are at the front of the separate place, they are holy chambers, where the priests (who are near to Jehovah) eat the most holy things, there they place the most holy things, and the present, and the sin-offering, and the guilt-offering, for the place is holy.
42.14: In the priests' going in, they come not out from the sanctuary to the outer court, and there they place their garments with which they minister, for they are holy, and have put on other garments, and have drawn near to that which is for the people.'
42.15: And he has finished the measurements of the inner house, and has brought me forth the way of the gate whose front is eastward, and he has measured it all round about.
42.16: He has measured the east side with the measuring-reed, five hundred reeds, with the measuring-reed round about.
42.17: He has measured the north side, five hundred reeds, with the measuring reed round about.
42.18: The south side he has measured, five hundred reeds, with the measuring-reed.
42.19: He has turned round to the west side, he has measured five hundred reeds with the measuring-reed.
42.20: At the four sides he has measured it, a wall is to it all round about, the length five hundred, and the breadth five hundred, to separate between the holy and the profane place.

43.1: And he causes me to go to the gate, the gate that is looking eastward.
43.2: And indeed, the honour of the God of Israel has come from the way of the east, and His voice is as the noise of many waters, and the earth has shone from His honour.
43.3: And according to the appearance is the appearance that I saw, as the appearance that I saw in my coming in to destroy the city, and the appearances are as the appearance that I saw at the river Chebar, and I fall on my face.
43.4: And the honour of Jehovah has come in to the house, the way of the gate whose face is eastward.
43.5: And take me up does the Spirit, and brings me in to the inner court, and indeed, the honour of Jehovah has filled the house.
43.6: And I hear one speaking to me from the house, and a man has been standing near me,
43.7: and He says to me: `Son of man, the place of My throne, And the place of the soles of My feet, Where I dwell in the midst of the sons of Israel to the age, Defile no more do the house of Israel My holy name, They, and their kings, by their whoredom, And by the carcases of their kings--their high places.
43.8: In their putting their threshold with My threshold, And their door-post near My door-post, And the wall between Me and them, And they have defiled My holy name, By their abominations that they have done, And I consume them in My anger.
43.9: Now do they put far off their whoredom, And the carcases of their kings--from Me, And I have dwelt in their midst to the age.
43.10: You, son of man, Show the house of Israel the house, And they are ashamed of their iniquities, And they have measured the measurement.
43.11: And since they have been ashamed of all that they have done, The form of the house, and its measurement, And its outlets, and its inlets, and all its forms, And all its statutes, even all its forms, And all its laws cause them to know, And write it before their eyes, And they observe all its forms, And all its statutes, and have done them.
43.12: This is a law of the house: on the top of the mountain, all its border all round about is most holy; indeed, this is a law of the house.
43.13: `And these are measures of the altar by cubits: The cubit is a cubit and a handbreadth, and the centre is a cubit, and a cubit the breadth; and its border on its edge round about is one span, and this is the upper part of the altar.
43.14: And from the centre of the ground to the lower border is two cubits, and the breadth one cubit, and from the lesser border to the greater border four cubits, and the breadth a cubit.
43.15: `And the altar is four cubits, and from the altar and upward are four horns.
43.16: And the altar is twelve long by twelve broad, square in its four squares.
43.17: And the border is fourteen long by fourteen broad, at its four squares, and the border round about it is half a cubit, and the centre to it is a cubit round about, and its steps are looking eastward.'
43.18: And He says to me, `Son of man, Thus said the Lord Jehovah: These are statutes of the altar in the day of its being made to cause burnt-offering to go up on it, and to sprinkle on it blood.
43.19: And you have given to the priests, the Levites, who are of the seed of Zadok--who are near to Me, an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, to serve Me--a calf from the herd, for a sin-offering.
43.20: And you have taken of its blood, and have put it on its four horns, and on the four corners of its border, and on the border round about, and have cleansed it, and purified it.
43.21: And you have taken the bullock of the sin-offering, and have burnt it in the appointed place of the house at the outside of the sanctuary.
43.22: And on the second day you do bring near a kid of the goats, a perfect one, for a sin-offering, and they have cleansed the altar, as they cleansed it for the bullock.
43.23: In your finishing cleansing, you do bring near a calf, a son of the herd, a perfect one, and a ram out of the flock, a perfect one.
43.24: And you have brought them near before Jehovah, and the priests have cast upon them salt, and have caused them to go up, a burnt-offering to Jehovah.
43.25: Seven days you do prepare a goat for a sin-offering daily, and a bullock, a son of the herd, and a ram out of the flock, perfect ones, do they prepare.
43.26: Seven days they purify the altar, and have cleansed it, and filled their hand.
43.27: And the days are completed, and it has come to pass on the eighth day, and now, the priests prepare on the altar your burnt-offerings and your peace-offerings, and I have accepted you--an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.'

44.1: And he causes me to turn back the way of the gate of the outer sanctuary that is looking eastward, and it is shut.
44.2: And Jehovah says to me, `This gate is shut, it is not opened, and none does go in by it, for Jehovah, God of Israel, has come in by it, and it has been shut.
44.3: The prince, who is prince, he sits by it to eat bread before Jehovah, by the way of the porch of the gate he comes in, and by its way he goes out.'
44.4: And he brings me in the way of the north gate to the front of the house, and I look, and indeed, filled has the honour of Jehovah the house of Jehovah, and I fall on my face.
44.5: And Jehovah says to me, `Son of man, set your heart, and see with your eyes, and with your ears hear, all that I am speaking with you, of all the statutes of the house of Jehovah, and of all its laws; and you have set your heart to the entrance of the house, with all the outlets of the sanctuary,
44.6: and have said to the rebellious, to the house of Israel: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Enough to you--of all your abominations, O house of Israel.
44.7: In your bringing in sons of a stranger, uncircumcised of heart, and uncircumcised of flesh, to be in My sanctuary, to pollute it, even My house, in your bringing near My bread, fat, and blood, and they break My covenant by all your abominations,
44.8: and you have not kept the charge of My holy things, and you set them for keepers of My charge in My sanctuary for you.
44.9: `Thus said the Lord Jehovah: No son of a stranger, uncircumcised of heart, and uncircumcised of flesh, comes in to My sanctuary, even any son of a stranger, who is in the midst of the sons of Israel,
44.10: but--the Levites who have gone far off from me, in the wandering of Israel when they went astray from Me after their idols, and they have borne their iniquity.
44.11: And they have been in My sanctuary ministrants, overseers at the gates of the house, and ministrants at the house; they slay the burnt-offering and the sacrifice for the people, and they stand before them to serve them.
44.12: Because that they serve them before their idols, and have been to the house of Israel for a stumbling-block of iniquity, therefore I have lifted up my hand against them--an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah--and they have borne their iniquity.
44.13: And they draw not nigh to Me to act as My priest, and to draw nigh to any of My holy things, to the holy of holies, and they have borne their shame and their abominations that they have done,
44.14: and I made them keepers of the charge of the house, for all its service and for all that is done in it.
44.15: `And the priests, the Levites, sons of Zadok, who have kept the charge of My sanctuary in the wandering of the sons of Israel from off Me, they draw near to Me to serve Me, and have stood before Me, to bring near to Me fat and blood--an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah:
44.16: they come in to My sanctuary, and they draw near to My table to serve Me, and they have kept My charge.
44.17: And it has come to pass, in their going in to the gates of the inner court, linen garments they put on; and no wool comes up on them in their ministering in the gates of the inner court and within.
44.18: Linen bonnets are on their head, and linen trousers are on their loins, they are not restrained with sweat.
44.19: And in their going forth to the outer court--to the outer court to the people--they strip off their garments, in which they are ministering, and have placed them in the holy chambers, and have put on other garments; and they do not sanctify the people in their own garments.
44.20: And their head they do not shave, and the lock they do not send forth; they certainly poll their heads.
44.21: And no priest does drink wine in their coming in to the inner court.
44.22: And a widow and divorced woman they do not take to them for wives: but--virgins of the seed of the house of Israel, and the widow who is widow of a priest, do they take.
44.23: `And My people they direct between holy and common, and between unclean and clean they cause them to discern.
44.24: And concerning controversy, they stand up for judgment; with My judgments they judge it; and My law and My statutes in all My appointed places they keep; and My sabbaths they sanctify.
44.25: And to any dead man they come not for uncleanness, but for father, and for mother, and for son, and for daughter, for brother, for sister who has not been to a man, they defile themselves.
44.26: `And after his cleansing, seven days they number to him.
44.27: And in the day of his coming in to the sanctuary, to the inner court, to minister in the sanctuary, he brings near his sin-offering--an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
44.28: And it has been to them for an inheritance; I am their inheritance: and a possession you do not give to them in Israel; I am their possession.
44.29: The present, and the sin-offering, and the guilt-offering, they do eat, and every devoted thing in Israel is theirs.
44.30: And the first of all the first-fruits of all, and every heave-offering of all, of all your heave-offerings, are the priests': and the first of your dough you give to the priest, to cause a blessing to rest on your house.
44.31: Any carcase and torn thing, of the fowl, and of the beasts, the priests do not eat.

45.1: And in your causing the land to fall in inheritance, you lift up a heave-offering to Jehovah, a holy portion of the land: the length--five and twenty thousand is the length, and the breadth ten thousand; it is holy in all its border round about.
45.2: There is of this for the sanctuary five hundred by five hundred, square, round about; and fifty cubits of suburb is to it round about.
45.3: And by this measure you do measure: the length is five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand: and in it is the sanctuary, the holy of holies.
45.4: The holy portion of the land it is; for priests, ministrants of the sanctuary, it is, who are drawing near to serve Jehovah; and it has been to them a place for houses, and a holy place for a sanctuary.
45.5: `And of the five and twenty thousand of length, and of the ten thousand of breadth, there is to the Levites, ministrants of the house, for them--for a possession--twenty chambers.
45.6: `And of the possession of the city you give five thousand of breadth, and of length five and twenty thousand, over-against the heave-offering of the holy portion: to all the house of Israel it is.
45.7: As to the prince, on this side, and on that side, of the heave-offering of the holy place, and of the possession of the city, at the front of the heave-offering of the holy place, and at the front of the possession of the city, from the west corner westward, and from the east corner eastward--and the length is over-against one of the portions from the west border to the east border--
45.8: of the land there is to him for a possession in Israel, and My princes do not oppress any more My people, and the land they give to the house of Israel according to their tribes.
45.9: `Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Enough to you--princes of Israel; violence and spoil turn aside, and judgment and righteousness do; lift up your exactions from off My people--an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
45.10: Just balances, and a just ephah, and a just bath--you have.
45.11: The ephah and the bath is of one measure, for the bath to bear a tenth of the homer, and the ephah a tenth of the homer: according to the homer is its measurement.
45.12: And, the shekel is twenty gerah: twenty shekels, five and twenty shekels, fifteen shekels--is your maneh.
45.13: `This is the heave-offering that you lift up; a sixth part of the ephah of a homer of wheat, also you have given a sixth part of the ephah of a homer of barley,
45.14: and the portion of oil, the bath of oil, a tenth part of the bath out of the cor, a homer of ten baths--for ten baths are a homer;
45.15: and one lamb out of the flock, out of two hundred, out of the watered country of Israel, for a present, and for a burnt-offering, and for peace-offerings, to make atonement by them--an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
45.16: All the people of the land are at this heave-offering for the prince in Israel.
45.17: And on the prince are the burnt-offerings, and the present, and the libation, in feasts, and in new moons, and in sabbaths, in all appointed times of the house of Israel: he does make the sin-offering, and the present, and the burnt-offering, and the peace-offerings, to make atonement for the house of Israel.
45.18: `Thus said the Lord Jehovah: In the first month, in the first of the month, you do take a bullock, a son of the herd, a perfect one, and have cleansed the sanctuary:
45.19: and the priest has taken of the blood of the sin offering, and has put on the door-post of the house, and on the four corners of the border of the altar, and on the post of the gate of the inner court.
45.20: And so you do do on the seventh of the month, because of each erring one, and because of the simple one--and you have purified the house.
45.21: `In the first month, in the fourteenth day of the month, you have the passover, a feast of seven days, unleavened food is eaten.
45.22: And the prince has prepared on that day, for himself, and for all the people of the land, a bullock, a sin-offering.
45.23: And the seven days of the feast he prepares a burnt-offering to Jehovah, seven bullocks, and seven rams, perfect ones, daily seven days, and a sin-offering, a kid of the goats, daily.
45.24: And a present of an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, he does prepare, and of oil a hin for an ephah.
45.25: In the seventh month, in the fifteenth day of the month, in the feast, he does according to these things seven days; as the sin-offering so the burnt-offering, and as the present so also the oil.

46.1: `Thus said the Lord Jehovah: The gate of the inner court that is looking eastward is shut the six days of work, and on the day of rest it is opened, and in the day of the new moon it is opened;
46.2: and come in has the prince the way of the porch of the gate at the outside, and he has stood by the post of the gate, and the priests have made his burnt-offering, and his peace-offerings, and he has bowed himself by the opening of the gate, and has gone forth, and the gate is not shut till the evening.
46.3: And bowed themselves have the people of the land at the opening of that gate, on sabbaths, and on new moons, before Jehovah.
46.4: `And the burnt-offering that the prince brings near to Jehovah on the day of rest is six lambs, perfect ones, and a ram, a perfect one.
46.5: And the present is an ephah for a ram, and for the lambs a present, the gift of his hand, and of oil a hin for an ephah.
46.6: And on the day of the new moon a bullock, a son of the herd, a perfect one, and six lambs and a ram, they are perfect.
46.7: And with an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, he prepares a present, and for the lambs as his hand attains, and of oil a hin for an ephah.
46.8: `And in the coming in of the prince, the way of the porch of the gate he comes in, and by its way he goes out.
46.9: And in the coming in of the people of the land before Jehovah at appointed times, he who has come in the way of the north gate to bow himself, goes out the way of the south gate, and he who has come in the way of the south gate, goes out by the way of the north gate: he does not turn back the way of the gate by which he came in, but over-against it he goes out.
46.10: And the prince in their midst in their coming in comes in, and in their going out he goes out.
46.11: `And in feasts, and in appointed times, the present is an ephah for a bullock, and an ephah for a ram, and for lambs the gift of his hand, and of oil a hin for an ephah.
46.12: And when the prince makes a free-will burnt-offering, or free-will peace-offerings, to Jehovah, then he has opened for himself the gate that is looking eastward, and he has made his burnt-offering and his peace-offerings as he does in the day of rest, and he has gone out, and he has shut the gate after his going out.
46.13: `And a lamb, son of a year, a perfect one, you do make a burnt-offering daily to Jehovah; morning by morning you do make it.
46.14: And a present you do make for it morning by morning, a sixth part of the ephah, and of oil a third part of the hin, to temper with the fine flour, a present to Jehovah, by a statute age-during--continually;
46.15: and prepare you the lamb, and the present, and the oil, morning by morning, a continual burnt-offering.
46.16: `Thus said the Lord Jehovah: When the prince gives a gift to any of his sons, his inheritance it is, to his sons it is; their possession it is by inheritance.
46.17: And when he gives a gift out of his inheritance to one of his servants, then it has been to him till the year of freedom, and it has turned back to the prince, only the inheritance of his sons is theirs.
46.18: And the prince does not take of the inheritance of the people to oppress them, out of their possession, out of his own possession he does cause his sons to inherit, so that My people are not scattered each from his possession.'
46.19: And he brings me in through the entrance that is by the side of the gate, to the holy chambers, to the priests, that are looking northward, and indeed, there is a place in their two sides westward.
46.20: And he says to me, `This is the place where the priests do boil the guilt-offering and the sin-offering, where they bake the present, so as not to bring it out to the outer court, to sanctify the people.'
46.21: And he brings me out to the outer court, and causes me to pass over to the four corners of the court, and indeed, a court in a corner of the court, a court in a corner of the corner.
46.22: In the four corners of the court are perfume courts, forty long, and thirty broad, one measure is to the four corners.
46.23: And a row is round about in them, round about to them four, and made with boilers under the rows round about.
46.24: And he says to me, `These are the houses of those boiling where the ministrants of the house boil the sacrifice of the people.'

47.1: And he causes me to turn back to the opening of the house; and indeed, water is coming forth from under the threshold of the house eastward, for the front of the house is eastward, and the water is coming down from beneath, from the right side of the house, from the south of the altar.
47.2: And he causes me to go out the way of the gate northward, and causes me to turn round the way without, to the gate that is without, the way that is looking eastward, and indeed, water is coming forth from the right side.
47.3: In the going out of the man eastward, and a line in his hand, then he measures a thousand by the cubit, and he causes me to pass over into water--water to the ankles.
47.4: And he measures a thousand, and causes me to pass over into water--water to the knees. And he measures a thousand, and causes me to pass over--water to the loins.
47.5: And he measures a thousand--a stream that I am not able to pass over; for risen have the waters--waters to swim in--a stream that is not passed over.
47.6: And he says to me, `Have you seen, son of man?' and he leads me, and brings me back to the edge of the stream.
47.7: In my turning back, then, indeed, at the edge of the stream are very many trees, on this side and on that side.
47.8: And he says to me, `These waters are going forth to the east circuit, and have gone down to the desert, and have entered the sea; to the sea they are brought forth, and the waters have been healed.
47.9: And it has come to pass, every living creature that teems, wherever the streams come, does live: and there has been great abundance of fish, for these waters have come there, and they are healed; and every thing where the stream comes has lived.
47.10: And it has come to pass, fishers do stand by it, from En-Gedi even to En-Eglaim; a spreading place of nets they are; according to their own kind is their fish, as the fish of the great sea, very many.
47.11: Its miry and its marshy places--they are not healed; to salt they have been given up.
47.12: And by the stream there comes up on its edge, on this side and on that side, every kind of fruit-tree whose leaf fades not, and not consumed is its fruit, according to its months it yields first-fruits, because its waters from the sanctuary are coming forth; and its fruits has been for food, and its leaf for medicine.
47.13: `Thus said the Lord Jehovah: This is the border by which you inherit the land, according to the twelve tribes of Israel; Joseph has portions.
47.14: And you have inherited it, one as well as another, in that I have lifted up My hand to give it to your fathers; and this land has fallen to you in inheritance.
47.15: `And this is the border of the land at the north quarter; from the great sea, the way of Hethlon, at the coming in to Zedad:
47.16: Hamath, Berothah, Sibraim, that is between the border of Damascus and the border of Hamath; Hazar-Hatticon, that is at the coast of Havran.
47.17: And the border from the sea has been Hazar-Enan, the border of Damascus, and Zaphon at the north, and the border of Hamath: and this is the north quarter.
47.18: `And the east quarter is from between Havran, and Damascus, and Gilead, and the land of Israel, to the Jordan; from the border over-against the eastern sea you measure: and this is the east quarter.
47.19: `And the south quarter southward is from Tamar to the waters of Meriboth-Kadesh, the stream to the great sea: and this is the south quarter southward.
47.20: `And the west quarter is the great sea, from the border till over-against the coming in to Hamath: this is the west quarter.
47.21: `And you have divided this land to you, according to the tribes of Israel;
47.22: and it has come to pass, you separate it for an inheritance to yourselves, and to the sojourners who are sojourning in your midst, who have begotten sons in your midst, and they have been to you as native, with the sons of Israel, with you they are separated for an inheritance in the midst of the tribes of Israel.
47.23: And it has come to pass, in the tribe with which the sojourner sojourns, there you give his inheritance--an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.

48.1: And these are the names of the tribes: From the north end to the side of the way of Hethlon, at the coming in to Hamath, Hazar-Enan, the border of Damascus northward, to the side of Hamath, and they have been his--side east and west, Dan one,
48.2: and by the border of Dan, from the east side to the west side, Asher one,
48.3: and by the border of Asher, from the east side even to the west side, Naphtali one,
48.4: and by the border of Naphtali, from the east side to the west side, Manasseh one,
48.5: and by the border of Manasseh, from the east side to the west side, Ephraim one,
48.6: and by the border of Ephraim, from the east side even to the west side, Reuben one,
48.7: and by the border of Reuben, from the east side to the west side, Judah one,
48.8: and by the border of Judah, from the east side to the west side is the heave-offering that you lift up, five and twenty thousand broad and long, as one of the parts, from the east side to the west side: and the sanctuary has been in its midst.
48.9: The heave-offering that you lift up to Jehovah is five and twenty thousand long, and broad ten thousand.
48.10: And of these is the holy heave-offering for the priests, northward five and twenty thousand, and westward in breadth ten thousand, and eastward in breadth ten thousand, and southward in length five and twenty thousand: and the sanctuary of Jehovah has been in its midst.
48.11: For the priests who are sanctified of the sons of Zadok, who have kept My charge, who erred not in the erring of the sons of Israel, as the Levites erred,
48.12: even the heave-offering has been to them, out of the heave-offering of the land, most holy, by the border of the Levites.
48.13: `And to the Levites over-against the border of the priests are five and twenty thousand in length, and in breadth ten thousand, all the length is five and twenty thousand, and the breadth ten thousand.
48.14: And they do not sell of it, nor exchange, nor cause to pass away the first-fruit of the land: for it is holy to Jehovah.
48.15: And the five thousand that is left in the breadth, on the front of the five and twenty thousand, is common--for the city, for dwelling, and for suburb, and the city has been in its midst.
48.16: And these are its measures: the north side five hundred, and four thousand, and the south side five hundred, and four thousand, and on the east side five hundred, and four thousand, and the west side five hundred, and four thousand.
48.17: And the suburb to the city has been northward, fifty and two hundred, and southward, fifty and two hundred, and eastward, fifty and two hundred, and westward, fifty and two hundred.
48.18: `And the residue in length over-against the heave-offering of the holy portion is ten thousand eastward, and ten thousand westward, and it has been over-against the heave-offering of the holy portion, and its increase has been for food to the servants of the city,
48.19: even to him who is serving the city, they serve it out of all the tribes of Israel.
48.20: All the heave-offering is five and twenty thousand by five and twenty thousand, square do you lift up the heave-offering of the holy portion with the possession of the city.
48.21: `And the residue is for the prince, on this side and on that side of the heave-offering of the holy portion, and of the possession of the city, on the front of the five and twenty thousand of the heave-offering to the east border, and westward, on the front of the five and twenty thousand on the west border, over-against the portions of the prince; and the heave-offering of the holy portion, and the sanctuary of the house, has been in its midst.
48.22: And from the possession of the Levites, from the possession of the city, in the midst of that which is to the prince, between the border of Judah and the border of Benjamin, there is to the prince.
48.23: `As to the rest of the tribes, from the east side to the west side, Benjamin one,
48.24: and by the border of Benjamin, from the east side to the west side, Simeon one,
48.25: and by the border of Simeon, from the east side to the west side, Issachar one,
48.26: and by the border of Issachar, from the east side to the west side, Zebulun one,
48.27: and by the border of Zebulun, from the east side to the west side, Gad one,
48.28: and by the border of Gad, at the south side southward, the border has been from Tamar to the waters of Meriboth-Kadesh, the stream by the great sea.
48.29: This is the land that you separate by inheritance to the tribes of Israel, and these are their portions--an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
48.30: `And these are the outgoings of the city on the north side, five hundred, and four thousand measures.
48.31: And the gates of the city are according to the names of the tribes of Israel; three gates northward: the gate of Reuben one, the gate of Judah one, the gate of Levi one.
48.32: And on the east side five hundred, and four thousand, and three gates: the gate of Joseph one, the gate of Benjamin one, the gate of Dan one.
48.33: And the south side five hundred, and four thousand measures, and three gates: the gate of Simeon one, the gate of Issachar one, the gate of Zebulun one.
48.34: The west side five hundred, and four thousand, their gates three: the gate of Gad one, the gate of Asher one, the gate of Naphtali one.
48.35: Round about is eighteen thousand, and the renown of the city is from the day Jehovah is there.'
